title: Peacock holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- peacock body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='72' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#2f7fd6'/>
  <!-- chest/belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='74' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#5fb0f0'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='40' y='52' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#2f7fd6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='8' fill='#2f7fd6'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='48' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#bfe4ff'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='46' r='1.6' fill='#e0559b'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='45.5' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='52,48 58,50 52,52' fill='#ffc93c'/>
  <!-- crest feathers -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='39' r='2' fill='#2fd6c0'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='37' r='2' fill='#2fd6c0'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='39' r='2' fill='#2fd6c0'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='41' x2='40' y2='44' stroke='#2fd6c0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='39' x2='44' y2='43' stroke='#2fd6c0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='48' y1='41' x2='48' y2='44' stroke='#2fd6c0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- tail fan -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='60' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#2fc06a' transform='rotate(-30 20 60)'/>
    <ellipse cx='16' cy='68' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#2fc06a' transform='rotate(-10 16 68)'/>
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='76' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#2fc06a' transform='rotate(10 18 76)'/>
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='82' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#2fc06a' transform='rotate(30 24 82)'/>
    <!-- eyespots -->
    <circle cx='21' cy='55' r='2.6' fill='#ffd23c'/>
    <circle cx='21' cy='55' r='1.2' fill='#2f7fd6'/>
    <circle cx='13' cy='65' r='2.6' fill='#ffd23c'/>
    <circle cx='13' cy='65' r='1.2' fill='#2f7fd6'/>
    <circle cx='15' cy='76' r='2.6' fill='#ffd23c'/>
    <circle cx='15' cy='76' r='1.2' fill='#2f7fd6'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='84' r='2.6' fill='#ffd23c'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='84' r='1.2' fill='#2f7fd6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wing arm holding string -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='66' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3a95ea' transform='rotate(-20 52 66)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='41' y1='84' x2='39' y2='93' stroke='#ffc93c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='84' x2='49' y2='93' stroke='#ffc93c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='93' x2='42' y2='93' stroke='#ffc93c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='93' x2='52' y2='93' stroke='#ffc93c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M57 64 Q64 48 70 30' stroke='#e8e8f0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='20' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='16' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ff9db0'/>
  <polygon points='72,33 69,37 75,37' fill='#c9334f'/>
</svg>
